messages:
maria_cs: FYI AsterBio hit another round of 503s this morning — looks like repeat from last week. Customer is asking for a postmortem and actions.

sam_support: saw the spike at ~09:12 PT, error rate peaked to ~8%. I pulled first 200 error logs.

jia_sre: thanks Sam. any obvious N+1 or backend timeout pattern?

sam_support: mainly upstream 502->503 cascade, tail latency on /v1/generate increased before failures. snippet: 
```
ERROR 09:11:56 upstream timeout service-model-1 502
ERROR 09:12:03 kv-cache-miss write timeout
```

jia_sre: that matches a KV write stall we saw on the node pool. I investigated and there were several evictions on nodes host-gpu-7. Will check autoscaler logs.

maria_cs: customer said this is impacting their daily batch jobs; renewal touchpoint scheduled next month. Devon, want us to escalate on the contract side? :worried: 

devon_am: flagging as high-risk for renewal if frequent. pls add clear mitigation + timeline. I'll prepare comms once we have owner + ETA.

sam_support: owner request: I can own the support ticket and gather logs, but need infra to confirm root cause.

jia_sre: I will own infra investigation and remediation. Action: check node-gpu autoscaler policy, evaluate padding and preempt buffers. ETA: EOD today for rollback plan.

maria_cs: action items so far:
- sam_support: consolidate logs + timeline and attach to ticket INC-11372 (today)
- jia_sre: infra RCA + mitigation plan (EOD)
- devon_am: draft customer note after we have RCA (tomorrow)

sam_support: created INC-11372 and uploaded initial logs + timeline. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-11372 :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-11372 created by sam_support at 2026-03-20T09:35:12Z

jia_sre: quick findings: autoscaler scale-up delay due to quota exhaustion on region-us-west2; fallback nodes spun up slower. Proposed mitigations:
- increase reserved capacity for critical pools (short term)
- tune scale-up threshold to 40% headroom
- add proactive buffer for account AsterBio routing (canary)

devon_am: proposed comms: apologize, explain brief root cause (quota + slow scale), list actions and ETA, offer 1:1 tech sync. I'll draft and share in #customer-comm-templates.

maria_cs: please confirm owners and deadlines in this thread so I can update the customer. Also want to capture enablement request: AsterBio asked for a runbook for throttling/queueing if they see 503s again.

sam_support: will attach a short runbook + example retry/backoff config by EOD tomorrow.

jia_sre: I'll provision a temporary reserved slot for AsterBio (48h) to prevent immediate recurrence. Note: needs approval from finance for extended reserved capacity.

devon_am: note on renewal risk: I'll mark high in CRM and request an escrowed credit for the next billing cycle pending impact review.

maria_cs: thanks all — next check-in in this thread at 17:00 PT. If owner complete earlier, post update and I'll consolidate for the customer. :pray:
